evals.name: trigger-build-new-feature
evals.prompt: Build a new referral feature in the shared module.
assertions: Stops at GATE 1 to confirm scope before creating any file
Reads core-facts, feature-template, platform-rules, library-guide, and component-catalog first

evals.name: trigger-add-screen
evals.prompt: Add a screen to the existing shift feature.
assertions: The build-feature skill is loaded in `screen` mode

evals.name: trigger-negative-review
evals.prompt: Review my KMP changes before I open a PR.
assertions: The build-feature skill is NOT loaded
Routed to the review-changes skill instead

evals.name: functional-scaffold-feature
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new `payout-summary` feature (new mode) that shows the monthly payout with loading and error states.
assertions: Stops at GATE 1 for scope confirmation; creates no file unprompted
Plan uses the feature-first layout per cmp-architecture-structure (ui/{contracts,viewmodel,screens} + data/ + di/); domain/ only with explicit justification
ViewModel extends androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel and uses viewModelScope only (no injected CoroutineScope)
Screen wrapped in SnabbitScreen; DS components + tokens only; collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
UiState list fields are ImmutableList; errors mapped to AppErrorType; one-shot effects per D2
